title: The Cow and the Beans
lines: Nick got a new pot at the shop.
He had to boil the beans a long time.
A crowd sat down on the brown soil.
Then a cow stuck its head in the pot!
The beans spilled out on the ground.
Nick had to frown and count his coins.
But the crowd found bread, and all was good.

questions.ask: What was Nick making for the crowd?
questions.listenFor: Beans, boiled in his new pot. Have them point to line two.

questions.ask: What went wrong with the beans?
questions.listenFor: A cow stuck its head in the pot and they spilled on the ground.

questions.ask: How do you think Nick felt at the end? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. The frown and the bread both give clues.
